title: Ozdrite
body:
#                         Ozdrite NeoForge 1.21.1      
 ![Tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c515dbcba57d45c96373a21b1484d6ed5b57040.png)                     
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

It adds a mysterious purple colored mine to the game, I guess these are the remains of ancient creatures? Just kidding, I decided to make such a mod inspired by my name, I hope you like it.
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

About

Adds Ozdrite ore and items to game! You can get this tools upgrading netherite with Ozdrite or craft like normal armor!

Ozdrite ore can be found on Y: -64 to 34

You need to use Ozdrite stick to make Ozdrite tools

Needs NeoForge
